title: Video review coaching and change in blinded operative skill scores among general surgery residents: a prospective observational study
abstract: Objective: to estimate whether residents who take part in monthly video review coaching gain more operative skill over one academic year than residents who do not. Design: prospective observational comparison in one general surgery programme. Participants: the 14 residents of the 2027 to 2028 academic year. Outcome: change in a blinded global rating scale score for laparoscopic cholecystectomy, adjusted for baseline score and training year. Results will be reported when rating is complete.
introduction: Video review coaching is spreading in surgical training because filming is now easy. Most published comparisons contrast one form of coaching with another or rely on unblinded ratings by supervisors. This study measures skill change blind to coaching status in a programme where coaching is voluntary.
methods: Every resident films one laparoscopic cholecystectomy at the start and one at the end of the year. Videos are edited to the critical steps and scored by two consultants who do not coach that resident, blind to coaching status and timing. Change in score is compared between coached and uncoached residents by linear regression adjusted for baseline score and training year. Study videos are kept out of assessment and deleted after rating.
results: No videos have been rated yet. The report will give the adjusted difference in change with its confidence interval, autonomy ratings and coaching attendance.
discussion: The estimate will be imprecise with 14 residents and will be presented as a local result and a source of planning values for a multi-programme study. Self-selection into coaching will be discussed as the main alternative explanation.
limitations: Small sample, self-selection into coaching, one programme and one index operation. Autonomy ratings are not blinded.
conclusion: To be written after rating. It will not claim an effect on patient outcomes.
summary: STROBE-structured draft with results left empty.
